targetTexts.1: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
targetTexts.2: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
targetTexts.3: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
targetTexts.4: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
targetTexts.5: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
targetTexts.6: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
targetTexts.7: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
targetTexts.8: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
targetTexts.9: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
targetTexts.10: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
targetTexts.11: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
targetTexts.12: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
targetTexts.13: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
targetTexts.14: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
targetTexts.15: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
targetTexts.16: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
targetTexts.17: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
targetTexts.18: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
targetTexts.19: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
targetTexts.20: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
targetTexts.21: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
targetTexts.22: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
targetTexts.23: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
targetTexts.24: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
targetTexts.25: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
targetTexts.26: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
targetTexts.27: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
targetTexts.28: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
targetTexts.29: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
